title: Seven one-line 'mode' prompts (red team, Socratic, creative director, CEO, teacher, devil's advocate, consultant) to paste at the start of a ChatGPT chat

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.detail: Prompts shown typed into the ChatGPT composer with reasoning set to 'Extra High'

claims: 'Most people tell AI what to do; people getting insane results tell it how to think first'
Pasting one line at the start of a chat 'completely changes how it thinks and answers'

Red Team mode finds every flaw; Socratic mode interviews you until it nails the question; CEO mode cuts to the 1-2 decisions that matter; Devil's Advocate argues the hardest case against you; Consultant mode produces a plan
how_to_steps: Pick a mode for the situation (red team when in love with your idea; Socratic when you do not know the question; creative director when safe is not enough; CEO when buried in detail; teacher for new topics; devil's advocate before committing; consultant for complex problems)
Paste the one-line mode prompt as the first message of a new chat
on_screen_only: Exact prompt 1: 'Enter Red Team mode. Challenge every assumption, find every weakness, and try to make my idea fail before the real world does. Don't be agreeable.'
Exact prompt 3: 'Enter Creative Director mode. Prioritize originality, emotional impact, and attention over being safe or obvious.'
Exact prompt 4: 'Enter CEO mode. Ignore the low-leverage details. Focus only on the biggest strategic decisions that will have the highest impact.'
Exact prompt 5: 'Enter Teacher mode. Assume I'm intelligent but brand new to this topic. Explain it using simple language, analogies, and examples.'
Exact prompt 6: 'Enter Devil's Advocate mode. Take the opposite position from mine and make the strongest possible argument against my thinking.'

Exact prompt 7: 'Enter Management Consultant mode. Analyze this the way a top-tier strategy consultant would. Break down the problem, identify the tradeoffs, and give me a prioritized recommendation.'
Socratic mode prompt text not shown (only a 'SOCRATIC MODE' graphic)
ChatGPT composer shows reasoning selector set to 'Extra High'
cta: Comment 'enter' on Instagram @Itsmariahbrunner to receive all seven prompts

relevance.why: Generic prompting; ChatGPT-focused. The red-team / devil's-advocate framing is mildly useful for a founder who makes decisions alone with no co-founder to push back.

implement_score.why: Cheap win: turn 'red team' and 'CEO' into Claude Code slash commands or a Council-style review step before shipping features or pricing changes. 15 minutes to add; six of seven prompts are fully visible on screen so no DM needed.

verify: No evidence offered that these outperform just asking for critique directly
